source.name: Footy Headlines, 'LASK 26-27 Home, Away & Third Kits Released'
source.quote: This is the new Adidas LASK home football shirt for 2026-2027.
source.note: Kit maker, recorded as partner per existing convention. Same article: 'Produced by long-term technical sponsor Adidas'; the kit was unveiled 'during a recent club partner event'.

summary: Original Kornspitz (backaldrin) large on the front and BWT on the upper chest, with adidas as kit maker; the men's shirt carries the sponsor-driven yellow sleeves that Footy Headlines notes the women's version drops. Official shop product photos show the sleeves carrying backaldrin's arrow marks and no back or shorts sponsor; the Admiral Bundesliga league patch and small marks (Technogym sleeve band, 'Change the World' hem patch, Oberösterreich crest) are on the shirt but could not be sourced from quotable page text, so they are named here rather than as records.
